name: BetaKit

sources.title: BetaKit homepage — Canadian tech & startup news publication
About page with pitch, tip, freelance and partnership routes
Freelance submission guide (linked from about page)

requirements: Canadian tech/startup focus — BetaKit is the publication of record for Canadian tech; stories need a Canadian angle
Editorial coverage only: there is no self-serve directory or listing
Newsworthiness required — funding, launches, layoffs, notable milestones
preparation: A concise pitch: what the company does, the Canadian connection, why now
For funding news: amount, investors, stage, founders, use of funds
Embargo timing and exclusivity preference if applicable
Relevant vertical (AI, FinTech, SaaS, cleantech, etc.) and region tags they publish under
workflow: Choose the right channel from the About page: 'Pitch your story' (contact form), 'Submit a tip' (/tips), or 'Write for BetaKit' (freelance guide)
Send the pitch or tip via the form at https://betakit.com/contact-us/ or https://betakit.com/tips
Wait for an editor response; follow up once if no reply in ~1-2 weeks
Coverage appears as an article on betakit.com if accepted
watchFor: This is earned media — no payment buys news coverage; the paid 'Partner with us' / Innovation Leaders programs are sponsorships, not listings
Non-Canadian startups are unlikely to be covered
Don't pitch pure SEO/marketing copy; reporters ignore it
Paid partnership content is labeled and separate from editorial
countsAsLive: A published BetaKit article (betakit.com URL) covering or mentioning the company
unknowns: Whether the tips/pitch forms guarantee any response
Whether company links in articles are dofollow
